title: RidgeExtractor shared params
description: Shared extractor params used by all four LineContinuity modes (Terminations, PatternChange, Correlation, Density). All four modes receive the same params dict; only relevant fields are used per mode.

use_contrast.description: When true, a per-pixel difference between the sample frame and a reference frame (e.g. tip without liquid) is computed before all other processing. The reference source is set in the A/B Compare dialog or via ImageSet.reference_frames. The contrast image replaces the normal working frame.

contrast_mode.description:
'absolute' — output = |sample − reference|. Values below contrast_min → 0; at or above contrast_max → 255; in between linearly scaled to 0–255.

'relative' — signed difference centred at grey (127). sample brighter → > 127; reference brighter → < 127. |diff| < contrast_min → 127 (neutral); |diff| ≥ contrast_max → 0 or 255.

contrast_blur_method.description: Blur applied independently to both sample and reference before computing the difference. Independent of any other blur step in the pipeline.

contrast_blur_kernel.description: Gaussian kernel size for the contrast pre-blur (must be odd). Only used when contrast_blur_method = 'gaussian'.

contrast_bilateral_d.description: Bilateral filter diameter for the contrast pre-blur. Only used when contrast_blur_method = 'bilateral'.

contrast_bilateral_sigma_color.description: Bilateral sigma colour for the contrast pre-blur. Only used when contrast_blur_method = 'bilateral'.

contrast_bilateral_sigma_space.description: Bilateral sigma space for the contrast pre-blur. Only used when contrast_blur_method = 'bilateral'.

contrast_min.description: Minimum contrast threshold (0–255). Differences smaller than this are suppressed: 0 in absolute mode, 127 (neutral grey) in relative mode. Filters noise and background flicker.

contrast_max.description: Maximum contrast cap (0–255). Differences at or above this are fully saturated. Values between contrast_min and contrast_max are linearly stretched to 0–255. Must be greater than contrast_min.

use_ab.description: True = use A:B accumulated difference frames; False = single frame.

blur_method.description: Blur method applied before gradient computation. 'none' skips blurring.

blur_kernel.description: Gaussian blur kernel size (must be odd). Only used when blur_method = 'gaussian'.

bilateral_d.description: Bilateral filter diameter. Only used when blur_method = 'bilateral'.

bilateral_sigma_color.description: Bilateral filter sigma in color space. Only used when blur_method = 'bilateral'.

bilateral_sigma_space.description: Bilateral filter sigma in coordinate space. Only used when blur_method = 'bilateral'.

roi_expansion_px.description: Expand (positive) or contract (negative) the calibrated ROI polygon outward by this many pixels before processing. Negative values shave off the outer edges — useful for excluding tip-wall artefacts. The resulting polygon is shown as ROI3 in the A/B Comparison and Stage Detail dialogs. 0 = use the calibrated ROI exactly as drawn.

gradient_method.description: Sobel gradient direction used to build the working magnitude map. 'xy' = combined magnitude. 'x' = |Gx| (emphasises vertical structure — recommended when use_ridges=false). 'y' = |Gy| (emphasises horizontal structure). 'none' = use pixel intensity directly.

gradient_ksize.description: Sobel kernel size. Use 3, 5, or 7 (odd values only).

use_ridges.description: When true (default), the standard ridge pipeline is used: gradient → orientation filter → threshold → binary mask → morphology. When false, those steps are skipped and band signals (PatternChange, Correlation, Density) are computed directly on the continuous float working image. This avoids hard-threshold fragility. The Terminations signal is not meaningful without ridges and will be zero. Recommended to pair with gradient_method='x' when disabling ridges.

angle_tolerance.description: ±degrees from horizontal accepted as a vertical-line gradient. Smaller = stricter orientation filter. Only used when use_ridges=true.

ridge_threshold.description: Minimum gradient magnitude to flag a pixel as a ridge. Only used when use_ridges=true.

morph_kernel_height.description: Height (rows) of the morphological structuring element. Only used when use_ridges=true.

morph_kernel_width.description: Width (cols) of the morphological structuring element. Only used when use_ridges=true.

morph_iterations.description: Number of morphological close/open iterations. 0 = disabled. Only used when use_ridges=true.

morph_close_enabled.description: Apply morphological closing to connect nearby ridge pixels. Only used when use_ridges=true.

morph_open_enabled.description: Apply morphological opening to remove small isolated ridge pixels. Only used when use_ridges=true.

band_height.description: Row count of each comparison band for pattern/correlation/density signals.

termination_window.description: ±row window for aggregating termination counts. 0 = exact row only. Only used by LineContinuity_Terminations.

ignore_top_rows.description: Number of rows from the top of the ROI to force to zero in the signal. These rows are excluded from POI detection and the graph shows 0 at these positions. Useful for suppressing artefacts near the upper ROI boundary.

ignore_bottom_rows.description: Number of rows from the bottom of the ROI to force to zero in the signal. These rows are excluded from POI detection and the graph shows 0 at these positions. Useful for suppressing artefacts near the lower ROI boundary.
